forum.title: Clock configuration
forum.best_answer_content: @gil\_dobjanschi, **RCC** is disabled. Please enable it and test one more time.
forum.author: gil_dobjanschi

scraped_replies.html: HSIDIV3 is the default after reset. Is it possible the clock has not been changed yet in your code? Where are you calling HAL_RCC_GetHCLKFreq in relation to clock being set? Including your IOC or code may help.
scraped_replies.author: TDK

scraped_replies.html:
Hi TDK,

I called it before mx_system_init and after mx_system_init in the while(1) loop of the application. It always prints 48MHz. I attached the zipped ioc2 file. 

 

Thanks,

Gil

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @STackPointer64,

I confirm that by simply activating RCC the clock value is now correct. Specifically it is 48MHz on startup, before  invoking mx_system_init, and 144MHz right after mx_system_init. Thank you for the help!

 

@Saket_Om, I'm glad I can help! 

 

Regards,
